<!--
Thanks for improving the skills! This becomes a change when it has corroboration and an eval.
Keep it GENERIC — a community fact, not your team's house style. Don't paste private code;
a minimal reproducing snippet is welcome and is the best evidence.
-->

## Which skill
<!-- haskell-coder, haskell-reviewer, or both -->

## What the skill said (or failed to say)
<!-- Quote the SKILL.md / reference guidance you followed, or describe the gap. -->

## What's actually better
<!-- The improved guidance, phrased as a general Haskell fact. These skills are intentionally
     opinionated — if you're revising an opinion, name the concrete tradeoff. -->

## Corroboration (required to merge)
<!-- EITHER an authoritative citation: GHC User's Guide / Haskell Report / Hackage Haddock / PVP,
     OR a minimal module that compiles/runs and demonstrates the point (paste it). -->

## Proposed eval (strongly encouraged)
<!-- A realistic prompt + what a correct answer must contain, that the current skill gets wrong.
     For haskell-reviewer, include the code to be reviewed. This is the test that proves the fix. -->

## Suggested change
<!-- Which file (SKILL.md / references/...) and roughly what edit. A draft diff is welcome. -->
